tei:div.tei:p: chos rgyal bod kyi rgyal rabs bzhugs so/ /

na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal chen po rnams// thugs rje'i spyan gyi ras su ma shor 'bar/ /thugs rje dang ldan rgyun du gzigs pa yis/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag zhing mchog bod yul gangs chen 'dir/ /de yi sprul pas mi yi 'gro ba spel/ /de rnams mgon du shākya'i rgyal rgyud byon/ /de dang de yi rgyu mtshan 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang bod kyi rgyal rgyud nyid kyang*/rje mang bkur rgyal po las rgyud pa sel ma zhugs par 'dod de/ de ni shākya chen po dang shākya li tsa bi/ shākya ri brag pa rnams las/ ri brag pa ni/ 'phags rgyal gyi yul gnas te/ rgyal po rtsib gyi mu khyud mtha' yas zhes pa la/ bu rgyal po gtum po rab snang de ni/ bcom ldan 'das dang zhag dus mnyam du 'khrungs par byed la/ de'i bu rgyud rgyal po skyabs seng*/ de'i bu bod kyi rjer gyur pa ni/ sngon gyi yig tshang rnams na 'di ltar snang ste/ dang por bod yul 'dir mi med/ mi ma yin du mas gang ba la/ srid pa cha'i sa yang 'dug cing*/ bod khams pa rnams/ dbra/ 'bru ldong gsum/ sga dang bzhi/ nu bo dba'as dha gnyis dang drug la bod mi bu gdung drug zer ba 'dug na'ang*/ thog ma rang ni bod kyi mi'u rigs bzhi po yin par sems so// de rnams bod mi snga shos yin/ khams rigs dbye ba mi'u rigs bzhi bya ba yod pa yin/ ye sang dkar po gnam kyi 'ju thag can dang gcig ye mon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba dang gnyis/ spyang phrug ye shes lha'i sgron me dang gsum/ mon rdzu nag po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhi'o/ /mi de rnams mang du 'phel nas bod la dbang byas te/ de dus gdong dmar can gyi yul zhes par grags shing*/ ma sang spun dgu rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rgyal phran bcu gnyis/ rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcus rim par dbang byas skad/ mkhan rjes dbang mdzad/

de nas dmu rje btsan pos bdud po ma ṭaṃ ru tra/ srin po yak+ṣa de ba/ klu rgyal gang ba rnams kyi rim par dbang byas so/ /de'i skabs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bkas bskul zhing*/ ri bo po ta la'i rtse nas byang la zhal gzigs te/ kha ba can gyi sems can rnams 'dren par dgongs te/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu gzigs pas/ kha ba can 'di ni 'dzam bu gling du/ yul gru chen po lnga'am dgu yod pa'i nang nas/ ngan shos su'ang 'dug cing*/ sangs rgyas kyis zhabs kyi ma bcags/ gsung gi 'od zer gyis ma khyab/ bstan pa'ang med/ gdul byar ma gyur pa mun pa mun nag lta bur 'dug pa la/ stod khams gsum ni gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba/ rdzing 'dra ba na/ sha dgo ri dwags kyis dbang byed/ bar khams brag dang spang gi bskor ba/ yur ba 'dra ba na/ spre'u dang brag srin mos dbang byed/ smad khams gsum nags kyi rdzing 'dra ba na/ glang po che dang*/ 'dab chags la sogs pas dbang byed/ mi'i 'gro ba med par 'dul ba'i skabs ma rnyed pa dang*/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams chos kyi snod du ma gyur pa/ de rnams 'dul ba la/ thog mar mi ru bsgyur ba'i/ sprul pa btang dgos pa 'dug snyam nas dgongs pa na/ spre'u yi gyad ha nu man+tha zhes pa de 'phags pa'i sku drung na byung ba la/ khyod kyis kha ba can du sgom nus sam gsungs pas/ nus zer ba la/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom khrims lnga phog mi sdug pa sgom pa'i chos bslab nas btang bas/ spre'u des kha ba can gyi yul gyis dbus/ brag chen gyi rtse la sgom pa'i drung du/ brag srin mo gcig nyin re bzhin byung nas/ mi tshangs par spyod par 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dang*/ de'i phyir du srog 'dor ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis tshul ston gyin 'dug pas/ spre'u snying rjes ma bzod de/

'phags pa'i drung du phyin nas/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ 'phags pa dang sgrol mas gnang ba byin te/ spre'u dang brag srin mos 'dod pa spyad pa las/ zla ba dgu ngo bcu nas pha ma mi 'dra ba spu dang mjug ma med pa gcig skyes pa de ni/ sha dmar po dang*/ khrag draun mo la rab tu dga' ba zhig go/ de nags tshogs can du spre'u'i khyur bskyal bas/ spre'u mo dang 'grogs nas lo gcig la de 'dra ba'i phrug gu bzhi brgyar 'phel lo/ /de rnams kyang pha rigs shas che ba ni/ dad pa dang shes rab dang*/ snying rje dang brtson 'grus che ba/ chos dang dge las la mos pa/ blo gros rgya chen po dang ldan pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' blo chen gyi rigs zhes bya'o/ /ma'i rigs shas che ba ni sha khrag la dga' ba| tshong khe sogs sems pa/ bdag 'dzin dang chags pa che ba/ skad che ba/ ngo mi rtag pa/ gzhan gyi skyon 'don pa la dga' ba/ mos gus dang dad pa chung ba/ bya byed mang ba/ mig mi la mi chags pa/ gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs sha stag byung ngo*/ /rigs rgyud de rnams 'phel ba'i ched du/ 'phags pas 'bras bu sna lnga dang*/ gser la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs kha ba can gyi phyogs la gtor/ byin gyis brlabs/ de la longs spyad pas/ sprel phrug mir gyur pa de rnams je mang la song bas/ 'bru la mi 'cham par/ tsho bzhir bgos pas/ se dang dmu ldong dang*/ stong dang*/ bzhi la mi'u rus bzhi zer/ la lar dbra/ 'bru/ zhang zhung*/ stong sum pa/ ldong mi nyag rnams bgrang pa na/ mi rje lhas mdzad pa ni gong bzhin/ rgya gar du rgyal po skyabs seng gi bu lnga'i bar pa/ mig bya ltar mas nas 'geb pa/ g.yu'i smin ma yod pa/ sor mo dra bas 'brel ba/ dung so 'khor ma yod pa zhig skyes pas rgyal po na re/ ltas ngan du 'dug pas sod cig gsung pa la/ blon po rnams kyi mtshon gyi gsod ma nus par/ zangs gyi ga'u kha sbyor du bcug gzer gyi bsdams nas/ chu bo gang gā la skur ro/

/de grong khyer yangs pa can gyi zhing pa rgan rgon gyi rnyed nas/ nags gseb tu gsos pas/ bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan rnams kyi yang zas skom bskyal/ rtse grogs byas/ ljon shing dang me tog kyang de la 'dud par byed do/ /der rgyal bu na re/ nga la 'khor ngan pa 'di lta bu gang yin/ nga'i pha ma su yin zer ba la/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bsnyad nas/ khyod phas ltas ngan du byas nas chur bor ba/ nged kyi rnyed pa sogs kyi gtam bsnyad pas/ yid skyo nas gangs gseb bros pas/ lha ri gyang mtho'i mkhar du byung*/ de nas rim gyi 'phyugs nas/ kha ba can gyi rgyal khams gyi dbus/ yul yar mo sna bzhi dang*/ lha yar la sham po mthong nas/ der byon/ lha ri gong po ri rtser phebs/ dmu'i skas la babs te/ btsan thang sgo bzhir byon pas/ ya gam lha sras dang*/ thog lha bon po la sogs shes pa can gyi bu tsha bcu gnyis/ phyugs skyong gin yod pa dang mjal/ de rnams kyi khyed su yin byas pas/ btsan po zer/ gang nas 'ong byas pas/ mdzub mo gnam la sgreng/ de'i skad ma go yang*/ 'di ni ngo mtshar can gcig 'dug pas/ nges par gnam nas byon pa'i btsan po gcig yin par 'dug 'o cag gis jo bo bya'o zer nas shing gi khri la bzhag gnya' bar khur nas khyim du phyin pas/ ming yang gnya' khri btsan por btags so/ /der phyugs rdzi rnams kyi rje'i bzhugs sa la/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar brtsigs te/ pho brang snga shos yin/ 'di la rgya gar nas byon pa'i lugs mi 'dra ba 'ga' snang zhing*/ bon po rnams/ gnam nas rmu thag dang*/ rkyang thag la byon no zer na'ang*/ gnya' khri btsan por thams cad mthun no// baud kyi rgyal po la snga ba de yin te/ 'di ni chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i shes bya rab gsal na/ thub pa mya ngan las 'das rting*/ lo stong lhag song pa na byon par bzhed do/ /des sum pa'i bon po a yang rgyal ba btul lo/ /de'i sras mu khri btsan po/

de nas bu rgyud rim pa bzhin/ ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ dwa khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/ srib khri btsan po dang bdun la| gnam gyi khri bdun zer/ de yan chad 'od gsal gyi lha dag yod pas/ sras kyi chibs kha thub pa dang*/ yab 'od kyi nam mkha' la byon pas/ lha lus ro med 'ja' ltar yal ces so/ /srib khris sras gri gum btsan po 'khrungs dus/ a phyi gdags kyi lha mo dkar mo la/ mtshan ci gsol bris pas/ a phyi rgas nas/ dbang po mi gsal bar brda don ma go ba la brten nas/ ming gri gum btsan por btags so/ /de la sras/ sha khri/ bya khri/ nya khri gsum 'khrungs ste/ yab de mu stegs kyi ston pa dig skad pa dang*/ shing sgrod pa dang*/ srog gzan pa bya ba rnams/ mchod gnas su rim par bkur ba'i skyon gyis/ rgyal po'i thugs gdon gyi bskyod nas/ rang gi blon po long ngam rta rdzi bya ba la/ khyod kyi nga'i 'thab zla bya dgos zer ba la/ zhu ba phul kyang ma nyan par/ nyang ro rtsib kyi thal la tshal du rje 'bangs 'thab pas/ long ngam thabs rten 'brel la mkhas pas/ rgyal po rang gi bod kyi ral gri la snga ba/ dgu zi glang po sna bya ba/ de klad la skor bas/ lha'i dmu thag chad/ lha nyams pas 'bangs kyi bkrongs/ spur de zangs kyi ga'ur bcug nas/ lci mda' zam kha nas/ nyang chu skya mo la bskyur btang bas/ rgyang mkhar pa tsha ru dgung zhag bdun dang*/ tshong 'dus mgur mo'i thad du gung zhag bcu gsum chags kyang*/ 'dzin mkhan med pas kong chu rlag tu khyer bas/ klu srin byed mo rje rigs mo'i bran mo/ klu srin bye ma lag ring*/ chu la nya bshor du phyin pas/ ga'u rnyed nas/ rje mo la phul bas bang mdzod du sbas so/ /de la stod kyi steng zer ro/ /rgyal bu gsum pos yab mes kyi bang mdzod na/ lha glang ru dkar bya ba'i/ glang 'phur shes gcig yod pa de la bzhon nas kong yul la braus so/ /de rnams kyi ma la long ngam kyis rta rdzi bcol/

lha gcig la chu ma bcol lo/ /ma des rta 'tsho ru phyin pas/ gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du/ mi dkar po gcig dang bshos pa rmis/ gnyid sad pa dang sngas kha nas g.yag dkar po gcig langs song ngo*/ /zla ba brgyad song ba na/ khrag gi gong po lag mgo tsam gcig skyes/ de bor ni ma nus/ gso ba la ni kha mig med/ 'gul gyin 'dug pas 'brong rwa zhig gi nang du bcug pas/ rkang rnams kyi ngar ma blo'i drod la btsos pas/ ci zhig tsam na/ bu khye'u zhig byung ba de'i ming*/ 'jang gi bu ru las skyes kyis ngar gsos por btags/ de lo bcu gnyis lon pa dang*/ pha dang pho bo gang na yod 'dri ba la/ sngar gyi rgyu mtshan bshad pas/ spur dang*/ pho bo spun zla 'tshol du phyin/ spur rnyed kyang slong bas ni mi ster/ rkus pas ni ma thob/ nyos rin ci dgos byas pas/ mi'i bu mo bya lo ma bya mig yod pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa zhig 'dod zer nas/ btsal pas/ g.ye'i gangs dbar yul gong nas/ pha mtshar la re then/ ma skyid la rung zhum gyis bu mo dge'u yu me bya ba/ de 'dra zhig 'dug na nyo bar byas nas/ pha na re gser mo rang tsam gcig 'dod zer/ ma na rai spur de la mtshal gyi thig brgyad cu rgyag chug zer ba/ khas blangs/ bu mo khyer/ spur blus so/ /kaung yul sen mo phug tu bang so brtsigs na'ang*/ der ma bzhugs/ bang so rtsig pa'i sngun ma yin no/ /de nas gcen sha khṛ kong po dang*/ gcung nya khri dwags po'i rje mdzad nas/ gdan ma 'drongs/ kong rje dkar po dang*/ nyang btsun rgyal po bya bar grags so/ /da lta'ang de gnyis na rgyal rgyud mang skad do// spu bo brag thog gi rje mdzad pa'i 'bring po/ bya khri gdan drangs nas rgyal sar bcug spu de gung rgyal du mtshan gsol lo/ /spu rgyal bod kyi yul bya ba de nas grags so/ /de nas spu rjai yar klungs su gdan drangs pas/ bon po spa ra'i bu/ kye rgyal sma bo ches/ gri btul nas/

lo bcu gsum song ba'i spur zangs de kha phyes pas/ skad nga ra ra zer bas/ yul de'i ming ni nga ra thang du btags/ de nas spur de 'phyongs rgyas grang mo grang chu kha'i zom la sbas pas/ gnam nas gser gyi thi gu gcig byung nas/ de la thim pas/ gnam la gser thig tu mtshan gsol/ de nas ru las skyes kyi nyang ro bsham po mkhar gyis ri rtse la/ bya rgod kyi gseb tu zhugs nas/ lo ngam pho mo dang*/ phrug gu thams cad bsad/ bsham po mkhar gyi rtse phab/ sku mkhar 'phying nga stag rtse'i rmang rdo byas/ she'u yug thams cad snangs su bcad/ der rje spu de gung rgyal 'a snyes kla mnyes bla nas/ ru las skyes la/ khu khu lha bu smon bzang bya ba'i ming btags/ yab gri gum btsan po'i ring la/ zhang zhung dang*/ bru sha'i bon pos/ gshin gyi 'dur bon byung ngo*// sa zin du bya bar mga' ra spun dgus brdungs pas/ bod ral dgu zi dang*/ dgu rogs zer ba 'di yang de dus nas dar ba'o/ /sras spu de gung rgyal gyi ring la| sku mkhar 'phyings pa stag rtse brtsigs/ sgrung dang ldeb byung*/ gnam bon gshen po bya ba byung ngo*/ /blon po ru las skyes dang*/ de'i bu lha bu mgo dkar gyi blon po byas pa'i ring la/ 'brong mthun du sdeb/ chu yur bar bcug spang zhing du rmos/ sol bas rdo bzhus nas/ gser dngul bcos/ snol rnam lde/ snol bo lde/ lde snol rnams/ lde snol bo/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan rnams la/ bar gyi sde brgyad ces zer ro/ /lde brgyad bang so chu bo'i gzhung la btab/ lde sprin btsan gyi sras/ rgyal po to re long btsan/ thon mi 'bring po rgyal dang*/ snubs smon do re/ 'dar gyi bu stong 'dar chen rnams kyi blon po byas so/ /'di yan gyi rgyal po rnams kyis lha klu'i bu mo dang bshos te/ btsun mo bsten dgongs pa la ma 'tshal zer nas/ sa la ro ma byung skad do/ /de rting 'bangs dang gnyen bsres pa ste/

rgyal po to re long btsan nas/ bu rgyud rim pa bzhin/ rje khri btsan nam/ blon po snubs gnya' to re gtsugs lo dang*/ rtabs khri bzung mong kheng gis byas/ rje khri dgra dpung btsan/ blon po mgar khri sgra ji thun dang*/ thon mi klu dbang bstad pos byas/ rje khri thog rje thog btsan/ blon mgar btsan gnya' ldom bu dang*/ snubs skyes thog rjai lo btsan gyi byas so/ /de yan mi rje lhas mdzad nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar la/ chab srid/ sgrung dang*/ ldebs/ bon dang gsum gyi bskyangs zer ro/ khri thog rje thog btsan dang*/ ru yong bza' stong rgya mtsho'i sras/ lha tho tho re snyan btsan ni/ bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po byon nas/ lo dgu brgya drug cu rtsa drug song ba'i me mo yos lo la 'khrungs so/ /de rnams la btsan lnga zer ro/ /rje de'i blon po khri thog rje btsan dang*/ sbrang khri bzung lan pas byas so/ /rgyal po de'i sku ring la rgya gar nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhan po si li byin byon kyang*/ bod na yi ge dang lo tsā shes pa gzhan med pas/ rgyal po'i phyag tu mchod pa'i rten la/ rags sku'i rigs lnga cha gcig bzhag nas/ khong rgya nag la byon no/ /der rting rgyal po lo brgyad cu bzhes pa/ sa pho spre'u'i lo la/ pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtser/ nam mkha' nas zangs kyi ga'u'i nang du/ dpa' skong phyag rgya ba dang*/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ gser gyi mchod rten 'khru gang pa/ tsan dan ma ṇi'i gzungs rnams byon te/ da nas gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sgra grags so/ /de chos yin par ma go na'ang*/ ngo mtshar can zhig go snyam nas/ pho brang gi rtser bzhugs/ gser skyems dang g.yu sngon sogs kyis mchod pas/ rgyal po dgung lo brgyad cu pa la se'u skyes/ skra dkar rnams por gyur/ gnyer ma med par gzhon sha chags zhing*/ lo brgya dang nyi shu thub/ rten de la gnyan po gsang ba zhes par mtshan gsol/

nga'i rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis 'di la mchod pa phul la/ gsol ba thob cig 'dod pa'i don rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyal po nyid 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sprul par grags shing 'di'i ring la/ bod du dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes par byed do/ /btsan lnga po'i bang sau yul du btab/ yul gyi ming ni 'phying lung so ra thang*/ btsan lnga'i chad pa sa phung sbra 'drar yod/ yul med che gru bzhi yi mi shes skad/rje de'i sras/khri snyan bzung btsan/ blon po sbas snang gzher zla btsan dang*/ mgar khri 'bring gis byas/ khri snyan chad pa don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ de yang yul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra/ de'i sras 'bro snyan lde ru/ blon po gnyag thang pa yang rje dang*/ snubs khri dar res thong pos byas/ de'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs dang*/ yab sras gnyis la/ bar gyi steng zhes zer/ de'i lo rgyus/ 'bro gnyan lde ru khab tu/ mchims za klu rgyal ngan bu zhes pa'i skyon gyis/ khong rang la klu nad tsi tsi dzā la byung nas/ yab yum gnyis blon po gnyag thang pa yang rje dang gsum ga gson dur la bzhugs dgos byung*/ sras gcig yod pa dmus long du gyur/ ming dmus long dkon pa bkra zer/ zhal chems la bsam pa bzang po gser dang 'dra ba ste/ /bzang po'i gros ni bdud rtsi yin pas nyon/ /ngan pa rnams ni me dang 'dra bas spongs// mi chos rtog pa yin pas rnam rtog skyur/ khyed kyis gnyan po gsang ba mchod// 'a zha'i sman pa bos la mig phye// mig ma byung na/ sum pa'i yul na bon po gcig gis chung ma/ rgyal mo rgya lcam bya ba dang*/ nga nub gcig 'grogs pa la/ bu sum ring po bya ba yod pa de bos la gcen chol/ rgyal sar chug gsungs so// 'gro gnyan lde ru'i bang so zhang mdar brtsigs/ de nas rmu long dkon pa bkras/ gnyan po gsang ba rgyas par mchod/ 'a zha'i sman pa bos nas pho brang yum bu'i rtser spyan phyes pas/

skyid shod stag mo'i ri la/ gnyan rtswa za ba mthong*/ mtshan yang stag ri gnyan gzigs su gsol nas/rgyal sar bcug de'i blon po de ni mon khri do ri snang btsan dang*/ sna nam mang gnya'/ sbrang khri gzung min rnams kyis byas/ yab sras de gnyis kyi bar du zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs skad do/ /gnyan gzigs bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ gral ni khri gnyan gong dngos ni g.yon na yod/ de yang yul med sa phung brdal ba 'dra/ de'i sras gnam ri srong btsan/ blon po sbas snang bsher dang*/ tshe spongs nag ser/ nyang rtseng dgu snon ban sngags gsum rnams kyi byas/ rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ rgya nag nas rtsis dang*/ sman dpyad byung na'ang cher ma dar/ rgya dang gru gu btul/ nyang sbal snon gsum mnga' 'og tu bcug sku mkhar khri brtsigs 'bum gtugs bya ba/ ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'jim pas brtsigs so// rgyal po des dmus te long ba khrid nas brag gsum ding ma mtsho'i 'gram nas rnyed pa'i rta cang shes la chibs/ sbrang dga' bo dang*/ dmu spun rgyang ring po bya ba'i gyad mi gnyis kyis khrid nas/ phung g.yag thal kha ru ring bya ba 'brong na le bong zan bsad nas yong*/ sha dras sga la btags pa sa la lhung pas/ lan tshwa rnyed de/ tshwa la drug cu sde byed pa byung*/ de gong bod na lan tshwa'i ming med do// 'di yi chad pa don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ de nas phul skyes brtsigs pa sogs mkhar yod/ gral ni khri gnyan bzung btsan g.yon na yod/ rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan la/ yum tshe spong bza' 'bri ma thod dkar gyi sras khri srong btsan ni/ me glang lo la/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gyi gling du/ mes pho tho tho ri snyan btsan nas lo brgya dang dgu bcu go gcig song ba'i dus/ sku 'khrungs nas/ lo bcu gsum nas yab 'das/ lo de nyid la rgyal por mnga' gsol/ chab srid lo drug cu re bzhi bzung*/ 'di ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos kha ba can du byon nas/

gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i phyir/ dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod pa'i tshul gyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzung ste/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i mdo dang*/ dam pa dang po'i rgyud las lung bstan pa bzhin yin la/ bod kyi rgyal po lo bcu bzhi pa gcig gis/ rgyal srid chos bzhin du skyong gin 'dug ces pa'i snyan grags kyis/ 'dzam bu gling khyab ste/ phyogs bzhi'i rgyal pos/ nor khyad par can gyi skyes dang*/ yi ge bskur byung ba/ bod kyi rgyal po la/ skyes lan bskur rgyu'i nor yod kyang*/ kha 'phrin ma gtogs yi ge med pas/bod la yi ge zhig ci nas kyang dgos pa 'dug dgongs nas/ thon mi a nu'i bu/ saṃ bho ṭa mi chung bya ba blo gsal bas/ gser bskur nas rgya gar du yi ge dang chos slob tu btang bas/ mkhas pa li byin na re/ ngas yi ge bris rigs mi 'dra ba nyi shu shes pas/ rgyal po'i 'gram du rdo ring la yi ge bris yod pa bstan nas/ slob ma khyod gang 'dod zer ba la/ bod kyi yi ge'i lugs 'di bslabs/ /lo tsā yang mkhas par shes/ slob dpon dang paṇ+ḍi ta/ shī la nan ta bya bas/ mdo dkon mchog sprin dang*/ tog gzungs/ snying rje pad dkar la sogs spyan drangs 'ongs pas/ rgyal po thugs rab tu dges so//bod kyi lo tsā ba dang*/ yig mkhan la snga ba de yin no/ /rgya gar na yi ge thams cad/ dbyangs yig dang gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi la/ mi tshud pa gang yang med na'ang bod sgra ngan pas de bzhin ma go rgya gar ba gcig la e ka zer/ 'jig rten la lo ka chos la dharma/ zhus la kri ta zer la/ smras pa zer dgos pa sogs bod skad du ma khug par/ thon mi thugs mug nas/ gzim khang gi sgo bsdams/ chum gzims nas gnyid log sad pa dang*/ gam na rgan po gu ba lta bu zhig 'dug rgan po gang nas yong*/ gar 'gro/ ngas sgau bsdams nas yod pa ji ltar byas nas yong*/ ci byed byas pas/ chos kyi don la 'gro 'ong med/

/yang dag don la ci bya med/ /nam mkha' dag la lam byas pas/ /sgo cha dam pas mi thub pa zer/ der the tshom skyes/ yang bskyar nas bris pas/ ngas za hor nas yong*/ 'a zha'i yul du 'gro zer/ thag ci tsam yod/ ci cha zer/ rgyags ji tsam yod/ ja yod zer nas rgan po mi snang bar gyur te/ de ni 'jam dbyangs gyi sprul pa'o/ /de nas bsam pas/ ca cha ja dang gsum/ zha za 'a dang drug byung ba/ de rnams bcug yi ge lnga bcu po/ ka mad sum cur bsdus nas/ bod kyi sgra skad dang mthun pa'i yi ge 'bru sdeb tu btub pa byung ba dang*/ bod kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas/ da nga'i yab mes kyi gnyan po gsang ba 'di'i nang na/ ci 'dug ltos dang zer klog pas/ mdo za ma tog dang*/ spang skong phyag rgya ba/ tsan+d+ra ma ṇi'i gzungs/ mu dra'i phyag rgya rnams bzhugs 'dug pa la mos nas/ rgyal pos kyang lo bzhir mtshams bcad/ yi ge dang chos bslabs so/ /mdo dkon mchog sprin la sogs pa thon mis spyan drangs pa rnams bod du bsgyur/ chos sgyur ba'i thog ma yin no/ /chab 'og thams cad la chos dang yi ge rgyas par spel cing*/ bod yig gi thog ma/ rgyal pos jo bo gtso 'khor gsum po'i bstod pa/ 'di brtsams nas lha sa zla ba'i brag la bskos nas phud du phul yod do/ /lha skyon gyi ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan can/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs mnga' zhing*//phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /dpal ldan mnyam sbyor la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'i gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bgrang 'phreng ni/ /mu tig ltar dkar g.yas na 'dzin/ /rigs sngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyi ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma shel gyi 'od pas gsal/ /pad+ma dkar po g.yon na 'dzin// phyag na pad+mo la phyag 'tshal/

/chos dbyings rnam dag dri ma med/ /zla ba'i 'od ltar rgyas pa'i yum/ /gzugs kyi lha mo yid 'ong ma/ /yi ge drug ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas yon tan gser mdog can/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po ltar// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /de dus rgyal po lo bzhir sgor ma byon pa des/ blon po rnams na re/ rgyal pos ci yang mi shes/ bod bde ba nged rnams kyis byas pa yin zer ba/rgyal pos gsan nas glen par brtsi na/ bod mi thul ba dgongs nas rgyal po gcig pu gnas pas kun bde ba yin te/ sngon yang khrims med pas/ shes pa can bcu gnyis mthar 'khyams 'dug da ngas dge ba bcu la dpe blang ba'i chos khrims bca'o gsungs/ bsad pa la stong nyis khri chig stong*/ rkus pa la brgyad cu 'jal/ byi byas pa la yan lag gcod pa/ rdzun byas pas lce 'breg par byas/ yang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims kyi gzhi bzung bar byas te/ dkon mchog la dad pa dang*/ skyo ngal med par sgrub pa dang don dam par sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal zhing sgrub pa dang*/ gtsug lag dang chos la blo sbyangs pa dang*/ pha ma la drin lan gsab pa la slob pa dang*/ yon tan can gyi rigs kyi rgan pa la bkur sti bya ba dang*/ sha nye dang mdza' bshes la gzhung drang por srong zhing*/ khong sems chung zhing dang du blang ba dang*/ ma brtags shing ma bcol ba'i las la rtogs 'dod med pa dang*/ yul mi khyim mtshes la phan gdags pa dang*/ gzhi drang por bsrang zhing khong sems chung ba dang*/ las dang spyod pa thams cad ya rabs kyi rjes su bsnyegs shing*/ phyi mig ring du lta ba dang*/ zas dang nor la tshod zin pa dang*/ drin chen gyi mi'i lan mi bcag bzang lan brlan pa dang*/ bu lon dus la 'jal zhing bre srang la g.yo mi bya ba dang*/ thams cad la snyoms par bya shing 'gran sems mi bya ba dang*/ gros kyi nang du bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa dang*/

rang tshod zin par bya ba dang*/ sems can gang la brdung ba'i sems mi 'chang ba dang*/ byams snying rjes skyong ba dang*/ bcu drug go /bod kyi khrims dang*/ chos rnams sky-id shod sho ma ra na bar gtan la phab pa'o/ /der blon 'bangs rnams dga' nas/ rgyal po 'di ni shin tu sgam po gcig 'dug go zer nas/ srong btsan sgam por mtshan gsol lo/ /gzhan yang skye bo tha mal pa rnams/ blo kha chos la drangs zhing dad pa'i phyir/ thog mar sgrung dang*/ lde'u dang*/ bon rnams bstan/ rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrung rgyud/ lde'u yi bkod pa ra sa 'phrul snang gis blo 'bur nang na bris nas bkod yod do/ /de dus blon po mang nyang po rje zhang snang la sogs pa mdzangs pa mi drug gis/ tshig drug drug sum cu so drug la sogs pas/ gtan tshigs gtan la phab/ bod ru bzhi stong sder 'byed/ sku srung phyogs bzhir bskos/ mi la yig tshang skur/ mdo ba'i rta la cho ris bris/ phu chu rdzing du skyil/ gzhung chu yur du drangs/ ri khyim klungs su brtsigs/ thang zhing du slaug zhing lhur bcad/ chur gru btsugs/ bre srang gtan la phab/ mtha'i rgyal phran rnams dang*/ lho mon/ rtswa mi shing mi la sogs pa thams cad mnga' 'og tu bsdus/ chab srid rnams bde zhing skyid par gyur te/ chos lugs la phal cher zhugs so/ /der rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ nga'i khrims rnams kyang btsan par byung*/ da chos kyi 'dul du btub par 'dug pas chos bya'o/ /chos byed pa la yi dam gyi lha dgos pas/ ci la bya snyam na/ tshes brgyad kyi srod la sprin gseb nas lha'i bu mo na re/ rgya gar lho phyogs mthar thug pa rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ bye ma'i gseb/ sing ga'i gling*/ kha sar pa ṇi sku rgyab/ glang po che nyal ba'i 'og gis/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong po'i khog na zhal bcu gcig pa'i sku rang byon gcig yod pa/ spyan drangs na kha ba can du don chen po byed par 'gyur ro/

/zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de la rgyal po thugs rab tu dgyes te/ rang gi smin mtshams nas 'od zer skyes pa'i sna la/ dge slong shī la a ka ra bya bar sprul nas/ skyod de spyan 'dren pa la btang ngo*/ /de nas dge slong des rgya mtsho'i 'gram na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi ring la rtsa ba zug gser thub kyi ring la lo 'dab rgyas/ 'od srung gi dus me tog shar/ shākya thub pa'i dus na 'bras bu smin/ de'i steng la rtsa ba rul nas 'gyel ba bye mas non nas/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i khog nas/ dal pos mchod cig ces pa'i sgra dang bcas bcu gcig zhal sor bcu gnyis pa/ phyag bcu pa/ ma nu ka'i mdog lta bu/ lta bas chog mi shes pa zhig byon pa de dang*/ tsan dan gyi tshal pa zhig bye ma'i gling nas/ 'jag ma'i phon zhig po ta la'i 'dam nas me tog myu gu'i sdong po tshal pa zhig grong khyer ke ru'i mchod rten 'khor lo'i nang nas/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ 'od srung*/ shākya thub pa rnams kyi/ sku gdung ring bsrel de la bzhugs pas byang chub shing gi mchod sdong gsum/ gnas chen brgyad kyi bye ma/ chu bo nai ra dza na'i 'gram du sangs rgyas kyi lhung bzed nas/ chu bo ba'i shul gyi bye ma/ rin po che sna gnyis rnams dge slong gi bsnams byon te/ mchod rdzas khyad par can bcu po de/ bod kyi rgyal po la phul bas/ thugs rab tu dgyes shing ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /dge slong de yang rgyal po la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ de'i smin mtshams su nub bo/ /de nas mchod g.yog la mtshan ldan ma bcu drug bskos te/ dus drug tu mchod pa phul cing*/ rgyal po rang lha'i drung nas 'ben gang mi 'da' sar bzhugs so/ /de nas yang rgyal po'i thugs la/ de bzhin rten khyed par can de 'dra gdan 'dren rgyu gar yod dgongs nas/ yi dam gyi lha de la gsol ba btab pas/ lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gsum 'phros pa bal yul gyi phar mtha'i lung pa gcig gi tsan dan gyi nags gseb na/

tsan dan ha ri'i sdong po gcig la phog 'dug pa/ yang rgyal pos sprul pa bkyes nas/ dge slong shī la a ka ra spyan 'dren du btang bas/ nyin mo tsan dan gyi sdong po la/ mtshan mo spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rang byung gsum gong 'og brtsegs mar bzhugs pa/ steng ma na re/ nga rgya bal gyi mtshams su zhog cig sa de na snga dro re la tshong dpon re sbos grir 'chi ba yod pa de chad do gsungs jo bo 'ja' ma li'o/ /bar ma na re nga bal yul yam bu ya 'gal du zhog cig de na mi mang po rims nad kyi 'chi ba yod pa de chad do gsungs pa de jo bo u khang ngo*/ /smad ma na re/ nga mang yul skyid grong du zhog cig zla ba re la grong dpon re mdze nad kyi 'chi ba yod pa de chad do gsungs/ de ni 'phags pa wa ti yin no/ /lha gsum po de ltar bzhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyal po la zhus pas/ 'dir ma phebs kyang sems can gyi don chen po byas 'dug gsungs nas/ shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /der rgyal po'i thugs la yi dam gyi lha dngos dang mjal phyin/ sems can gyi don la tshegs med/ bod 'bangs kyi 'gro don phyogs gang nas 'grub brtag dgongs nas gzigs pas/ mes po tho tho ris byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa des zhabs kyi bcags pa'i skyid smad lha sa dmar po ri'i phyogs der/ theg pa chen po'i chos spel du btub par dgongs nas/ mchod gnas rnams shing rta la spyan drangs/ rgyal blon rnams byon/sbra stod tshal du zhag mal mdzad/ sang gro btab sar rgyal po dang blon po tshos chu khar khrus mdzad/ chab gsol dus dbus kyis gye rer yi ge drug ma 'byon par lung bstan to/ /dmarapo ri rtser phebs yab mes kyi bzhugs shul du pho brang btab nas bzhugs/ de nas ngas sems can gyi don byed par dam bcas pa yin pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i thabs gang legs dgongs nas/ lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer skar mda' lta bu gnyis/

shar nub du song bas/ rgya nag dang*/ bal yul du thims pas/ khro gnyer can dang*/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa spyan drongs zer ba'i sgra byung nas/ sngon la blon po mgar dang*/ thon mi mi chung gnyis gyi 'go byas/ rta pa brgya la gser gyi dong rtse brgya dang*/ gser gyi bang ba bdun/ glang po che gser gyi dra ba lha'i rin po che'i brgyan pa zhig gser phyai bre phyed/ yi ge bcu pa'i gser dngul zangs gsum gyi sgrom bu dang bcas pa bskur nas/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes brgyad/ skar ma nab so'i nyi ma rtse shar la/ bal po'i lha gcig slong ba la brdzangs so/ /der khong rnams kyi/ nub phyogs bal po'i pho brang yam mkhar du slebs/ rgyal po 'od zer go cha dang mjal/ rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ bal bza' khri btsun skal rdzongs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yi dam mi bskyod rdo rje/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ tsan dan sgrol ma'i sku rang byung gcig dang bcas pa gnang ba/ gdan drangs nas pho brang dmar po rir phebs so/ /de nas bal bzas rgyal po thugs mi skyo zhing*/ pha rol gyi dmag gi mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rin po che mang po sbyar/ gnod sbyin pho mo mang po bran du bkol nas/ dmar po ri'i khongs su bcug pa'i so phag gi lcags ri/ gyang rim sum cu rtsa gnyis dang mnyam pa/ srin yul lang ka pu ri'-i grong khyer dang 'dra ba/ mkhar dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i rtse mo nyag stong du tshang ba| mkhar re re la mdung ba dan dmar po can bzhi re btsugs pa/ phyogs re re na sgo dpe bzhi srung mi yod pa/ rtse mkhar la bya ra ba mi lnga re rgyun du yod pa/ de'i lho ngos lcags ri'i nang na/ pho brang sog po mkhar bya ba dgu thog dang*/ rgyal po'i rtse mkhar mnyam pa/ de gnyis lcags thag gis sbrel nas/ dngul zam la rgyu ba/ mkhar dang lcags ri rnams la mda' yab dang*/ sgo chung dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ pha gu dang*/ kha bad dang*/ rta babs rin po che'i dril bu er kha/

mu tig gi dra ba dra phyed rnams kyi brgyan pa/ pha rol gyi dpung gis mi tshugs pa zhig bzhengs so/ /der rting yang blon po mgar dang*/ thon mis 'go byas/ rta pa brgya la gser gyi dong rtse brgya/ gser phye bre phyed/ rin po che'i gos gcig rnams bskur nas/ shar rgya nag po'i lha gcig slong ba la brdzangs so/ khong rnams kyi rgya'i bkra shis khri sgor slebs/ thang tha'i dzung rgyal por zhus pas/ de'i sras rgya mo kong jo rdzongs ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ yi dam gyi lha shākya thub pa/ gab rtse drug cu skor/ bzo sna bco brgyad/ sman dpyad chen mo/ 'bru sna tshang*/ g.yog pho mo mang po dang bcas pa gnang bod du phebs/ lha sa'i mthil bye ma'i gling nags gseb/ chu mig gi 'gram du/ lha'i shing rta byings nas/ gyad lha dga' klu dgas btegs kyang ma thegs pa/ jo bo de khar bzhugs pa yin/ sa dgra mnan pa la dgongs pa'o/ /sku srung la gyad gnyis bzhag gos dar gyi bla yol gyi spyad do/ /der kong jo rgyal po dang mjal/ yab yum gsum blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dga' mgur spyod do/ /de nas rgyal po'i thugs la/ lha rten gsung rab 'di rnams bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs dgos dgongs nas/ kong jau la rtsis byas pas/ yul de na bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad la sogs pa'i dge du ma tshang 'dug kyang*/ lar bod yul kha ba can 'di srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba dang 'dra/ 'o thang gi mtsho 'di srin mo'i snying khrag tu 'dug pa 'di gnon dgos/ de la'ang*/ dang po ru bzhi'i lha khang brtsig dgos zer nas/ dpung mgo g.yas pa la ka tshal/ g.yon pa la khra 'brug brla g.yas pa la gtsang 'gram/ g.yon pa la grom pa rgyang brtsigs so/ /yang srin mo'i yan lag bzhi gnon pa'i phyir/ mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ gru mo g.yas pa la kong po bu chu/ g.yon pa la lho brag mkho mthing*/ dpus mo g.yas pa la ka brag g.yon pa la pra dum rtse babartsigs/

srin mo'i nying lag bzhi gnon pa'i phyir yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi ni/ lag mthil g.yas pa la/ byang mtshal gyi rlung gnon/ g.yon pa la khams su klong thang sgron ma/ rkang 'go g.yas pa la byams sprin/ g.yon pa la mon bum thang skyer chu rnams bzhengs/ der rt-ing ra sa'i rmang gting yang zhig nas rtsig tu ma btub pa la rgyal pos/ tsan dan gyi lha la gsol ba btab pas/ sngon la lho phyogs su pho brang brtsigs la/ der mchod pa'i rten ngo mtshar can rnams spyan drongs shig de nas rim gyi 'dod pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zer ba byung nas/ bal bza' la bka' bsgos nas/ lho phyogs ngos su pho brang brtsigs/ mchod pa'i rten rnams spyan drangs/ rgyal po yang phebs nas/ sngon la lha khang bzhengs/ der rting yi dam gyi lha zhig kyang bzhengs par dgongs te/ bal po'i lha bzo ba la bka' gnang ste/ lha'i rgyu khyad par can dang*/ lag cha rnams rgyal po'i spyan sngar bsags/ sang nyin nas lha bzhengs brtsis la/ de nub pho brang gi mthong khung na mar/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar shar ste byon/ lha'i rgyu la thims song bas/ rgyal po'i dgongs pa la/ nga'i yi dam 'di la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang byin rlabs mnyam pa zhig yong ba 'dug pa shin tu legs/ de yang bod kha ba can pa'i lha skal thugs rje chen po rigs lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi nang nas/ gang bzhengs na drags dgongs pa la/ sang nam lang tsa na/ dbu'i sngas kha na rgyal po rang dang sku bong mnyam pa'i/ bcu gcig zhal zhig rang byon du 'dug pas/ shin tu legs na'ang*/ tsan dan gyi sku rang byon 'di dang*/ mchod sdong 'di gsum lha'i khong snying du bzhugs pa zhig byed dgos bsam pa yin te/ gsungs pa dang lha sku rang gi phyag gnyis gyi rang gi sham thabs pus gong du brdzais te/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil nas 'od zer 'phros/ tsan dan gyi sku dang mchod sdong gsum po spyan drangs/

thugs kar bzhugs pa'i sku shin du sbram/ a mi dhe wa yang g.yon gyi phyogs su yo/ zhabs sngar shul du byon kyang*/ sham thabs pus gong du lus te/ chags pas rgyal po shin tu ngo mtshar cing dgyes par gyur to/ /der rting rgyal pos yi dam la gsol ba btab pas/ zhal dbus ma nas 'od zer byung*/ lho nub la wa ba tshal du dug gi sdong po la phog de 'thor bas 'dre srin gyi bdud dpung bshig 'od zer phrag pa la phog pas/ kha sar pa ṇi dang*/ rta mgṛn/ a mi de wa rnams kyi sku dod 'dug pa bzhin 'bur du brkos yod cing*/ brag lha can gdong zhes par grags so/ /'od zer de nub phyogs brag lha klu phug gi ma mo'i nyal sa phrogs/ rgyal pos sprul pa bkye nas/ phyag stong spyan stong gi bzo mdzad/ bal po'i lha bzo bas lo ke shwa ri dang*/ kha sar pa ṇi/ dbyangs can ma 'od zer can ma rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rnams bzhengs ste/ gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs so/ /de nas jo mo ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyi/ ma mo'i nyal sar/ bcom ldan 'das rnam snang kun du 'od kyi zhal brag la 'bur du dod par bzhengs/ pho brang gi lho nub btsan gyi rgyug srang yod sar/ mchod rten ke ru brtsigs/ klu'i pho brang steng gi gser gyi lha shākya mu nes mnan zin/ rgyal pos phyogs bzhi dang*/ sa dgra brgyad mnan/ bkra shis pa'i rtags brgyad po gsal bar byas pa ni/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad sa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi bar na/ han dkar stag mo'i ri la gdugs yod/ ra ka'i brag la nya yod/ rdzong tsan gyi brag la bum pa yod/ grib se sgrom na dung yod/ yugs ma'i zur na rin po che dpal be'u yod/ bshun gyi ri la rgyal mtshan yod/ der rting yon tan thams cad thon pas/ ra sa'i lha khang rtsig tu btub par mkhyen nas bod kha ba can du legs so cog 'phel cing*/ nyes so cog sgrib pa'i phyir du/ rgyal pos sprul pa lnga stong bkyes nas lha khang bzhengs/

btsun mo dam pa bal bza' khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang*/ rgya bza' kong jos rgya stag ra mo che/ zhang zhung bza' li tig sman gyis/ khram bu lkog ma/ ru yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis/ brag lha klu phug mong bza' khri lcam gyis/ yer ba'i lha khang rnams bzhengs so/ /ra sa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas lo gsum lon tsa na/ bod 'bangs byin pos nam zla dus bzhi'i/ rtsis ma shes shan ma phye ba la/ rgyal pos dgongs pa la ngas chos 'jig rten gyi khrims 'chos/ bod 'bangs dge la skul thub pa byung na'ang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtaug gi dra ba sel thabs/ rgya dkar nag gi rtsis kyang rgyas par spel nas/ rgyal khams la phan gdags dgos snyam pa 'khrungs te/ bod phrug blo gsal ba/ 'bre gnya' brtan bya ba dang*/ lang tsho ldong legs/ bya gag stong kun/ 'dar mi stag kha dang bzhi po la cha rkyen mang du bskur nas/ rgya nag la rtsis slob tu btang*/ rgya'i rtsis pa khṛ ma hā ya na la sogs la/ lo gcig zla ba bdun gyi bar du gtugs/ gson gshin gyi rtsis phal che ba shes par byas nas/ yar slebs pas/ rtsis la mkhas pa mi bzhir grags pa byung cing*/ khyad par bya gag stong khun nas/ pha tshe bu rabs su rje'i bla rtsis byas pa'i rigs rgyud ni/ da lta ga rings pa tshang yin par byed do/ /de nas bod rgyal po blon po bcu drug dang bcas nas/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar byon nas/ rgya'i so kha 'bul ba dang*/ kong jo'i lan dus kyi khas blang chad btsan par bya ba'i phyir/ lha khang mang po bzhengs/ lo bcu gsum gyi ring la/ rgya bod du lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs tshar ba'i rting ma la/ rab sgang du yongs rdzogs lha khang bya ba bzhengs so/ /bka' khol mar chos rgyal 'di'i ring la/ rgya gar nas slob dpon ku mā ra dang*/ bram ze shang ka ra/ bal po'i slob dpon shi la mañdzu/ rgya nag gi slob dpon ha shang ma hā ya na la sogs pa spyan drangs/ sde snod gsum dang*/

rgyud kyi cha lag mang rab bsgyur cing*/ rgyal po rang gi zhal nas/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ma bu brgya rtsa brgyad gsung*/ lha sa'i byang chub gling gi rta mgrin zhabs 'og na gter du sbas yod bya ba dang*/ zhang zhung gi yul nas/ bon po'i grub thob zhang zhung lha ldem bya ba bos nas/ bod mi a ho rnams bsags/ bya ba bon slob tu bcug nas/ nad pa'i rim 'gro sogs la bon yang dar bar mdzad do/ /zer ba 'dug mdor na bod 'bangs rnams lung gi chos la yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ khro bo dkyil du nad pa dang*/ sman pa dang*/ mo ma rnams dang*/ bon bos shwa ba nam mkha' la 'gro shes pa sprul nas/ nad brtag pa dang*/ de la khrom rnams ngo mtshar skyes pas/ da ltar gyi nad pa 'di 'dra rnams las/ ches na ba'i ngan song gsum dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjod pas yid ma ches/ spre'u'i gyad ha nu man tha'i sgrung bshad nas bod kyi rigs rgyud dang*/ las kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa mdo sde dang sbyar bas yid ches/ bslab pa gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ bon byas nad pa gso las phan che ba'i bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan sangs rgyas kyi rgya gar du mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i dod por/ rgyal pos ra sa'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa'i lo rgyus yod cing*/ khro bo sme brtsegs kyi rgyab na mchod rten brgyad po bya ba yod do/ /de lta bu'i chos rgyal chen po 'di ni/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dngos yin par grags zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol legs po gtod nas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa sa pho khyi lo shar ba'i stod la/ spyi dgos su zhal gdams mang du gsungs zhing*/ der rting rgyal po dang*/ bal bza' khri btsun/ rgya bza' kong jo yab yum gsum gar 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang byang mar/ rang byon bcu gcig zhal gyi thugs khar thims so// rgyas par bka' chems bka' khol mar blta bar bya'o/

/'ga' re rgyal po 'phan yul zal mo sgang du grongs zer ba 'dug ste/ blon po sna chen po dang se ru gung ston la sogs/ gros la dbang ba rnams kyi bod 'bangs byin po spro ba bsring ba'i phyir du re zhig zal mo sgang du snyung ba skad dang*/ sku gshegs pa'i tshul byas par byed do/ /rgya bza' kong jo lcags mo glang lo la rgya nag nas byon/ bod yul du lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs par byed do/ /srong btsan bang sau 'phyongs rgyas mda' ru btab// che chung tshad ni dpag chen mda' rgyang gang*/ /nang na lha khang lnga yang byas so skad// bang so nang rgyan can du grags pa yin/ /bang sau gru bzhir brtsigs pa de nas byung*/ /ming la smug ri smug po legs so skad/ /rje de dang*/ mon bza' khri lcam gyi sras/ gung srong gung btsan/ blon po ni/ mang po rje zhang snang dang*/ snubs btsan do res byas/ chab srid lo lnga bzung*/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la 'das nas/ slar yang yab kyi rgyal srid bzung ba phyed mar bgrang skad/ gung srong bang so don mkhar mda' ru brtsigs/ /gral ni gnam ri srong btsan g.yon na yod// ming ni gung sri gung chen legs so skad/ /rje de dang*/ sha bza' kong jo mo rje'i sras/ mang srong mang btsan lo bcu gsum nas/ mes po 'das/ lo bco lnga'i bar la srid bzung*/ blon po mgar stong btsan yul zung dang*/ 'chi mas 'das gnyer gyi byas/ lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la gtsang gi bang snang du 'das so/ /mang srong bang so srong btsan g.yon na yod/ ming sdong shar sral po bya ba lags/ rje de dang 'gros khri se khri ma lod kyi sras/ 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal po ni/ chu mo bya lo ba ste/ ma 'khrungs gong tsam du yab 'das/ 'khrungs 'phral nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar la srid bzung*/ 'di'i ring la bod du rol mo'i rnam grangs mang po 'byung ba'i snga ltas la/ rtsal po che mi bdun byung ba ni/

ar po ldong btsan gyis seng ge dkar mo'i gnya' ba nas bzung byung skad/ mon khri bzang gi stag dar ma gnyis lcags thag gi sbrel nas ngar sgras lung pa bkang ste khṛd byung skad/ lho don dam yang dag 'phags kyis/ seng ldeng gi gdung chen po bcu gsum gyi steng du/ gong dza la lcags dos gcig rgyab nas khur byung skad/ lcog ro zangs dkar gyis/ lha sa'i rdo ring rked la btsugs nas yo ga yo gin khur byung skad/ rngog rings nag pos bal yul nas glang po che'i phrug gu zhig gson por khur byung skad/ mgos shag byung gis/ sha ba yu mo'i blud bu tshwas rgyangs nas klad la dbyug gin byung skad/ smon rgyal mtshan rnam grags kyis/ mig mthong gsum de mda' rgyang gang res sleb cing*/ gtsang po la phar mchongs tshur mchongs byed kyin sleb byung skad do/ /rgyal po 'di snyung ba'i dus gcig bya yid du 'ong ba gcig gis sngar ma mthong ba'i shing gi yal 'dab nyung shas zhig pho brang gi rtser khyer byung ba/ ci yin brtag pas/ rje'i zhal skyems la phan par byung ba la brten nas/ blon 'bangs blo kha nye shos rnams kyis/ phyogs bcur btsal bas sngar bod na med pa'i ja shing rnyed/ de 'thung ba'i snod la/ bod dkar byang skya dar tshe bya ba bzos pa lags/ bzang ngan gyi dbye ba drug te/ bzang shos sham tshe la/ bya kha na shing khyer gyi ri mo yod/ de 'og lab tshe la/ mtsho nang nya dang bcas pa yod/ de 'og shang tshe la/ spang ri sha ba dang bcas pa'i ri mo yod/ theg tshe/ deb tshe/ rdo tshe gsum ni phal dkar ste/ri mo med pa'am/me tog la sogs sna tshogs yod/ ja dang dkar yol gyi sngon ma de nas byung bar byed do/ /rgyal po 'di'i ring la bod ma yin pa'i 'jang yul la sogs rgyal khams mang po 'og tu bcug mnga' thang che bar byung*/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la 'jang yul du 'das/ spur gnyer lcog gru khung khri zhes bya bas byas so/

/'phrul rgyal bang so mang sraung g.yon na yod/ ming ni seng ges brtsigs pa can no skad/ /bang so 'di nyid lcags ris bskaur nas yod/ /de ni hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs so skad/ /der rje dang mchims bza' btsan la me tog gi sras/ khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshom du grags pa de/ lcags pho 'brug lo pho brang ldan dkar du 'khrungs/ de'i lo gzhug la yab 'das/ srid bzung blon po sba skyes bzang stong btsan dang*/ mchims rgyal gzugs/ skyi sho ting 'gro chu bzang hor mang gsum gi byas/ de yang mes srong btsan gyi lung bstan/ zhal chems su bzhag pa de nga yin snyam du dgongs nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas zhi ba spyan drangs/ theg chen gyi mdo lnga dang*/ de bzhugs pa'i brag dmar mgrin bzang*/ brag dmar ka chu/ lha sa 'khar brag 'phying bu nam ral/ ma sa gong dang*/ lha khang lnga bzhengs/ rgya nag ke shang nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang*/ mdo las rnam 'byed bsgyur/ bi ji tsan pa shi las/ sman dpyad bsgyur/ 'di'i ring la pho brang 'phying nga stag rtse nas g.yu rdog chen po gcig rnyed do/ /des btsun mo 'jang bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes pa la| sras shin tu mtshar ba gcig btsas pa las/ 'jang tsha lha dbon du btags/ de'i khab tu 'os pa bod na med pas/ rgya nag rgya rje wing 'jung zher gyi sras mo/ kim shing kong jo blangs/ kong jo ma slebs pa la/ gnyags khri bzang 'don gyi bu mo ma blangs pa la ko long byas nas/ 'jang tsha gnyags kyis bkrongs so/ /ljang tsha lha dbon bang so yab kyi mdun/ zlum por brtsigs nas yod skad do/ /der yab dang*/ kong jo 'dus pa'i sras/ khri srong ldai btsan ni/ mes srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs rting*/ lo brgya dang bdun cu don bzhi song ba'i lcags pho rta lo la/brag dmar du sku bltams/ yab ni dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa la ya 'brog sbal tshan khar 'das so/ /ag tshom bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/

gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i g.yon na yod/ ming ni lha ri gtsug nam bya ba lags/ khri srong lde btsan dgung lo bcu gsum pa la/ yab 'das te/ rgyal srid lo bzhi bcu rtsa gsum bzung*/ 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul par grags zhing*/ 'dis dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ khyad par de'i dgung lo 'ga' zhig gi bar la/ sdig blon ma shang khron pa skyes kyis gros ston nas/ sngar phan rgyal rgyud sku tshe thung ba la sogs pa rnams chos khrims byas pas lan pa yin/ da bar chad zlog thabs la bod kyi lugs bzhin sus ma byas pa la 'chad pa byed zer nas/ lha shākya mu ne bye thebs su bcug pa dang*/ mang yul du skyel ba dang*/ dkon gnyer ha shang rgan po rgya nag la bskrod pa dang*/ 'bangs gum pa la dge rtsa mi gtong ba la sogs pa'i khrims bu chung bcas/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i bya ba mang po byas 'dug pa thams cad rgyal bu rgyal sar ston 'phral nas bkag ma zhang khron pa skyes gson dur du bcug jo bo mang yul nas gdan drangs/ dam chos dar bar byas pa dang*/ bsam yas kyi lha khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ bod 'bangs rnams shed gcog par bya ba'i phyir/ khyed rnams kyi ngas 'dod pa'i las/ gdam ga bzhi yod pas 'di rnams gang rung zhig byed dam/ lha khang zhig bzhengs gsung pas/ lha khang bdams nas/ rgyal pos dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon nas stag gi lo la sba ye shes dbang po'am/ dba'as gsal snang la sogs rnams za hor gyi yul nas/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa spyan 'dren pa la btang*/ phebs nas/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rmangs bting bas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams phrag dog che bar byung nas/ dba'as mang po rje dang*/ seng gho lha lung gnyis/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug nas spyan 'dren du btang*/ dam chen gyis bskul nas/ slob dpon mang yul nas tshur 'byon pa dang mjal/

bsus nas rgyal po yon mchod mjal sar/ slob dpon gyis nga che nga gnyan gyi mgur gsungs pa/ klu rgyal mal gro pa la klu gter bcug lha srin thams cad dam la btags nas lha khang bzhengs pas/ nyin mo las mtshan mo mgyogs par brtsigs/ zur phud dbu mtshal klu yis shing phul/ der rgya gar o tan ta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du byas/ khor sa phy-i nang rim pa bdun du byas/ gling chen po bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ nyi zla gnyis rnam sa kyi lha khang thams cad/ mdo rgyud sde snod gsum dang mthun par/ phyi lcags ri zur mangs 'khor gdugs dang bcas pa rgyal pos bka' gnang nas bzhengs/ btsun mo dam pa dkar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyis/ khams gsum zangs khang gling*/ 'bro bza' byang chub sgron gyis dge rgyas bye ma gling*/ pho yong bza' rgyal mo btsun gyis/ bu tshal gser khang gling*/ yum gyim shang kong jos/ dam pa'i shing khang rtse dgu bzhengs/ blon po chen po shud bu dpal seng dang*/ rgyal tsha lha snang*/ stag sgra klu gong*/ mchims rdo rje spre chung rnams kyis mchod rten chen po bzhi bzhengs/ de rnams shing phau stag lo spyir zla ra ba'i tshes bdun/ skar ma rgyal la 'gram bting nas/ lo drug la thams cad 'byongs te/ sa mo lug la mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang*/ slob dpon pad+mas rab gnas mnga' gsol mdzad dus byang chub sems bskyed gling gi lha gtso bo rnam snang nam mkha' la 'phags pa la sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'phrul mang du byung bas/ rgyal po thugs rab tu mnyes shing*/ blon 'bangs thams cad ngo mtshar dad mos tshugs par gyur te/ dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes par mtshan gsol/ rgyal pos rje'i dga' glu bcu gsum bya ba dang*/ blon po chen po rnams gyi skyid pa'i dpal dgu la sogs pa mi res bkra shis pa'i glu re blangs/

brag dmar mtsho mo'i mgur/ me tog pad sdaung rang 'khrungs lo bcu gsum gyi bar la skyid kyi bro mo che brdungs/ dga' staun rgya chen po byas/ de nas lha khang rnams kyi dkon gnyer byed mkhan dgos pa byung nas/ des rkyen byas yon mchod bka' bgros te/ sba gsal snang dang*/ dba'as khri bzher/ ba gor bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'khon klu yi dbang po srung ba/ rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub rnams la/ btsun pa byar rung mi rung nyams sad pas/ khyad par du 'phags pa byung bas/ bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba sad mi mi bdun du grags pa byung*/ de rnams la ska ba dpal brtsegs la sogs/ lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug de rnams la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ zhang ban de ye shes sde la sogs/ lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug nas/ mtshan nyid kyi chos dar bar byas shing*/ lug lo la dge 'dun de rnams mkhan po'i chos lugs bzhin yod par smra ba'i sde tshugs/ rgya gar nas dbu ma'i dge slong bcu gnyis gdan drangs nas/ dbu ma bye brag tu smra ba'i sde btsugs/ dam chos dar zhing rgyas par byas la/ lo gcig gi bar la chos mang po bsgyur te/ mkhan po'i zhal nas bod du mu stegs mi 'byung gis/ bstan pa 'di la gnyis su gyes nas rtsod par 'gyur te mthar rtsod pa phyogs gcig zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ der rting mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i dbu la chibs pa'i 'phra phog nas mya ngan las 'das/ spur bsam yas has po ri'i rtse la mchod rten brtsigs nas bzhugs so/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyir bod yul du mi lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs te/ lha klu gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags/ sa gzhi gnas gangs brag mang po gnas chen du byin gyis brlabs/ chos gter nor gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas/ gsang sngags la yang lo tsā ba sad mi mi drug bya ba byung te/

gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ 'dre rgyal ba blo gros/ ru gong bir+ya rtsa/ gru gu u pe sha dpal rlangs kyi seng ge lang gro dkon mchog seng ge rnams kyi blon po la gsang sngags kyi chos skor ma lus pa zhus cing*/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ lcai ku ku ra tsa la sogs pa'i/ lo tsā byas nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sdai mang po gsungs pa rnams bsgyur to/ /gzhan yang gnyags ku mā ra dang*/ so zur snubs gsum/ mkhan po rdo rje rin chen la sogs/ dkyil 'khor bco brgyad du grags pa'i slaub ma grub thob mang du spel/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad nas/ lho nub rnga yab gling la gshegs te/ lha sras mu ne

kla tig bla btsan pos thog drangs bod kyi blaun 'bangs mang pos mang yul gung thang gi la khar skyel ma byas/ la thog tu pad+ma bka' chems su grags pa'i zhal gdams gsung nas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la chibs te/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i gzhal yas khang du byon/ da lta srin po'i kha gnon mdzad cing*/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'o/ /yang bod kyi dge slong mi lnga/ tshe 'di la sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'tshol du rgya gar la btang*/ bai ro tsa nas chos lon no/ /yang tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i chos 'dod gsung nas/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i mchod gnas/ mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra gdan 'dren pa la/ ka cog gnyis dang*/ rma rin chen mchog btang*/ kha che'i yul du mjal/ bsus nas yon mchod mjal dus rgyal blon rnams la/ slob dpon 'di phyi pa gcig yin pa 'dra snyam pa'i log lta byung ba la/ lha rnam snang dang*/ rgyal po la phyag 'tshal grabs byas pas/ log lta sel dad mos che bar byung cing*/ gdams pa mang du zhus so/ /yang rgya nag ha shang 'dul ba la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shī la gdan drangs nas/ rtsod du bcug pas ha shang pham nas/ rgya nag la braus sar lham ya gcig lus pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus phyi mor/ bod du nga'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'ga' re yong ba 'dug zer ro/ /slob dpon ka ma la shī las sgom rim gsum brtsams nas rgyal po la phul/ gang zag las dag pa rnams ni/ ka ma la shī la'i chos lugs dang*/ lta ba la zhugs pa'o/ /yang sing gha la'i blo dpon dha na shī la sogs/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs nas/ rang rang gi yul skad dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos gsung tshad thams cad/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na/ ka cog zhang gsum la sogs/ rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi rim par bsgyur/ mdo rgyud man ngag 'chad nyan sgom sgrub ky-i bstan pa nyi mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing*/ yang ya rabs kyi skye bo pho mo brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dus gcig la rab tu byung te/ shar du dga' ldan lha phug

lhor stag tshang seng ge phug nub tu brag dmar po thon/ byang du ar+ya pa lo'i phug dang bzhir sgom grwa chen po yang btsugs/ mkhas grub chen po bzhi'i rtse gcig gi sgrub pa mdzad cing bskyangs so/ /yang jo mo 'brau bza' byang chub sgron gyi sku tshe'i smad la g.yas ru smad kyi lha khang dang rgyal bu mu tig btsan pos/ shangs su mtshal gyi lha khang*/ jo mo dkar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyis/ sku tshe'i smad la dpal chu bo ri'i lha khang bzhengs/ mchims bza' lha mo btsan dang*/ mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gnyis kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas/ lha khang phyag rjes med do/ /sba ye shes dbang po la sogs chos blon rnams kyi yang lha khang mang du bzhengs so/ /chos rgyal de'i ring la gso byed sman gyi rig pa yang dar bar mdzad la/ de yang bod du sman dpyad bsgyur ba'i dus gsum byung ni/ dang po chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la/ gso ba rig pa'i dbu brnyes/ lha sras khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ srol gtod/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi ring la sman dar zhing rgyas par mdzad zer la/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' gnang*/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa nas phyogs thams cad kyi sman pa spyan drangs nas/ rgya gar shan+ti gar bha la sogs kyis bod du bsgyur nas/ spyir sman pa la mkhas par grags pa dgu bcu rtsa gnyis byung*/ de'i nang nas dar byed kun tu grags pa'i sman pa bzhi bcu rtsa lnga/ khyad par rgyal po'i bla sman du bskos pa dgu ni/ stod na bi ji che rdzi 'ug pa gsum/ bar na mi nyag brang ti g.yu thog gsum smad na gnya' dang 'thab zhi stod dang gsum/ zhes bya ba'i drang srong sprul pa mkhas btsun ldan pa'i sman pa rim par byung ste/ rgyal po'i lung gis/ nga ni kun gyi lha yin la/ /'di dag nga yi rje yin pas/ /kun gyi lha rjer mtshan gsol la// mchod cing bkur sti'i gnas su bstan/ /gsungs pa'i 'phrin gyi dril bsgrags so/

/rje de'i blon po ni/ mgos khri bzang yab lhag dbas rgyal to re/ khri gsum rjes stag sna/ gnyags stag btsan ldong gzigs la sogs pas/ mdzangs kyi las thabs byas/ zhang rje rgyal gzigs dang*/ stag sgra klu gong gis phyi dgra btul/ rgya'i bkra shis khri sgo phab pa la sogs kyi lo rgyus phyis rdo ring la yod do/ khri gsum rje stag snas/ rgya dang gru gu 'jang gsum gyi mol 'dum byas/ rgya bod mtshams su bod kyi dpa' bo mi dgu'i 'go byas/ skye 'dus kyi dmag dpung so kha srung ba la bzhag pas/ bka' ma log zer ba'i bod 'brog gi sde mang po chags pas/ mtha' dmag bod du mi 'jug pa sogs/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'di ni/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas/ bod la bka' drin shin du che'o/ /'di'i dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa/ shing mo glang gi lo la zur mkhar du sku gshegs so/ /khri srong lde btsan bang so mu ra ri la yod/ /ming ni 'khrul ri gtsug snang bya ba yin/ /bang so phyi rgya can zhes bya bar grags/ /'di'i rtsa na rdo ring yi ge bris pa zhig kyang yod/ rje de dang*/ tshe yong bza' dkar rgyal me tog sgron gyi sras bzhi la/ gcen mu khri btsan po sku gzhon nu la gshegs nas bang so med do/ /de 'og mu ne btsan po chu pho stag la brag dmar du 'khrungs/ lo gcig zla dgu rgyal sa bzung/ yab kyi dus mchod la/ tshul 'jug gis zla ba la bsam yas su mdo sde mchod pa dang*/ cho 'phrul zla ba la 'dul ba'i mchod pa btsugs/ bod 'bangs byin po'i dbul phyug theng gsum snyoms kyang*/ rang rang gi sbyin shugs yin par dgongs/ mngon pa'i mchod pa 'dzugs rtsis la sogs/ khrims gnyis dar bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yod na'ang*/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la dug gis bkrongs so/ /'khrul chen mu ne btsan po'i bang so ni// ag tshom bang so'i mdun ngos g.yas na yod/ /ming ni lha ri ldem bu bya ba yin//

de'i 'og mu tig kla rug bla btsan pos/ zhang rgya tsha lha snang bsad pas/ de tshang gi g.yo thabs kyi bkrongs so/ /mu tig kla rug bla btsan po'i bang so don mkhar mda' na yod/ /ming ni skya rengs ldem pa lags so skad/ /gcung po khri lde sraung btsan/ shing pho 'brug la brag dmar du 'khrungs/ lo bzhi pa la btsan po 'das nas/ khong la rgyal srid bskos pa'i nyams sad pa'i phyir/ khri steng du bzhugs/ dbu la nor bu'i gtsug rgyan gsol bas/ ljid ma theg par mjing pa yon tsam byung na'ang*/ bkra shis pa'i rtags mang du byung bas/ sad na legs mjing yon zhes pa'i mtshan chags/ rgyal srid lo sum cu rtsa gnyis bzung*/ blon po sa mang rje ldang ldong dang*/ sgra rgyal mtshon skong gi byas/ paṇ+ḍi ta b-i ma la mi tra dang*/ ka ma la shī la/ dzñā na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba la sogs pa rnams kyi sngar skad sna tshogs kyi bsgyur ba'i chos thams cad/ rgya gar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pas/ rgya gar gyi skad zhe gcig tu bsgyur/ bod skad gsar bcad kyi gtan la phab/ snga so'i yab mes rim pas lha khang mang du bzhengs 'dug gi ngas ni 'dzam bu'i gling du che tshad thub pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs par 'dod pas/ nyi ma tsam dang zla ba tsam dang*/ skar chen gyi tshad tsam bzhengs pas/ sa dmigs tshol cig gsungs pa la blon 'bangs byings po'i blo la ma chud de/ chu dang brag gi bkag nas de 'dra shong sa bod yul na ni mi bdog zer ba rim par zhus pas/ 'o na skar ma chung shos kyi tshad rgyang grags yin zer ba de tsam zhig bzhengs so gsungs nas/ skar chung rdo rje dbyings gyi lha khang bzhengs/ rab byung thams cad kyi 'tsho ba sbyar/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs su bshad grwa bcu gnyis/ yer pa dang mchims phu la sogs su sgom grwa bcu gnyis btsugs/ stangs 'bul 'bul drug sems phyogs gnyis su byas nas dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/

lha sa'i khyam phra bzos/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa me mo bya lo la sbrags kyi phur 'das so/ /rgyal chen bang so 'phrul rgyal mdo na yod/ /yum gyi chab gang skong pas nang gi mthong*/ /ming ni rgyal chen 'phrul rigs lags so skad/ /de'i mdun na yi ge yig tshang bris pa'i rdo ring zhig kyang yod do/ /rje de dang 'bro bza' mang po rje'i sras lnga la/ gtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral pa can/ lhun rje/ lhun grub rnams las/ gtsang ma chos la dga' ches/ dar ma sdig la dga' ches pas rgyal sar ma bskos/ lhun rje lhun grub gnyis gzhon nu la 'das pas bang so med do/ /bar pa ral pa can ni mes khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs nas/ lo bdun cu don drug song ba'i/ me pho khyi lo la 'u shang rdor sku 'khrungs lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus blon po rnams gros byas nas/ rgyal sar bskos srid lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar la bzung*/ blon po bran kha dpal yon dang*/ 'bro khri bzung rams shags/ 'dre khri rje stag snang gsum gyi byas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ su lan+d+ra bo de pra dzñā dhe ba/ shin+ting gar bha rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdai la sogs pa mang pos dag ther legs par mdzad/ sngar ma bsgyur ba rnams kyang bsgyur/ 'u shang rdor dpal dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang rgya phibs dgu brtsegs khyung nam mkha' lding ba 'dra ba bzhengs/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par dam bcas nas/ ma 'byongs pa rnams gsos/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar lha khang dang*/ sha chu sdong btsan gyi mtsho dkyil du/ lcags kyi sdong po'i steng du/ sangs rgyas stong gi lha khang dang*/ glang yul du/ ring po gsum par/ sle'u 'phrul gyi kre'i dang 'og tu/ ka brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ 'o du byams chen lha khang*/ nyang ro rtsig sna gsar du lha khang khrab sgo can rnams bzhengs/ btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul las/

btsan thang g.yu'i lha khang dang*/ nya bza' mchog lha mos/ smon 'gro stag mtshal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ gcen dar mas 'dre'i lha khang dang*/ de'i gcen mo btsan po 'phan gyi/ yar klungs su dpag bsam ljaun shing dang*/ phug po che'i lha khang dang*/ mkhas btsun sngags pa dang*/ btsun chen rnams kyi/ brag lha mgon po dang*/ yer pa yang g.yan dang*/ nyang ting 'dzin bzhi'i lha khang dang*/ bran ka dpal yon gyi g.yas mtshal dang*/ dam yul me long thang*/ ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis ka ba yul sna/ tshe spongs stag bzang rab mdos/ stong lung lhag ma/ tshe spongs lha bzang klu dpal gyis/ bo dong bya rgod shong kyi lha khang rnams bzhengs so// lar ni 'di yan la bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyi rgya bod du/ gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad bzhengs par 'dod do/ /chos rgyal de ni sngon sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan par byed cing*/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags/ 'phrin las kyi gtso bo dam chos la spyod/ dkon mchog mchod/ tshogs gnyis kyi nor gsog rgyal khrims chos bzhin du skyong*/ rab tu byung ba re re la/ 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ 'tsho ba sbyar bkur sti dang phud dud bgyis/ bstan pa'i gshed dang*/ mnga' thang skyed yab mes kyi ring la chab 'og tu ma chud pa'i/ shar phyogs rgya nag po dbang du 'dus/ spo lon shan dar dkar gyis yol ba bkrams pa 'dra ba la gtugs/ nub phyogs stag gzig gi so mtshams/ stag sha dung gi sgo mo 'dra ba dang*/ byang phyogs hor gyi so mtshams/ bye ma rkang ring nya yi rgyab 'dra ba dang*/ lho phyogs mon lta la wa ta'i shel gyi dum bu 'dra ba/ de rnams la gtugs shing 'dzam bu gling gi sum gnyis dbang du 'dus par byed do/ /bod rgyal po'i mnga' thang che shos la byung bar gda'o/ /de'i dus tsa na khyim ni bag gro/ mi ni khong dal/ phyugs ni lo dang zla ba na sdud/ mi nyal nyi ma klong*/ 'bri yan sna med/ rta yan sgrog med/

sgo la khyi med/ rje byams 'bangs gus/ grogs gzhung bzang*/ gnyen sha tsha/ pho ni dpa'/ mo ni mdzangs la chas bzang*/ bod 'bangs byings po bde skyid la longs spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa na/ sku drin shin tu che'o/ /'di yan chod la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu dang*/ shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang lnga zer ro/ /phyed po ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang*/ mes ag tshom gyi sras gzhon nu la 'das nas/ rgyal srid bskyar ya re bzung ba la zer ro/ /der rting nag po'i phyogs dar tu nye ba dang*/ bod spyi mthun gyi bsod nams 'gribs pas/ rje la btsun mo/ cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul ma dang*/ mchims bza' skar rgyal/ sna nam bza' mang mo khong legs/ nyang bza' mchog gi lha mo/ tshe spong bza' mthor rgyal ma dang lnga yod kyang srid ma zin/ rgyal po'ang ha cang chos la dad ches pas/ sba stag sna la sogs sdig blon rnams kyi ban chen po bkums/ lha sras gtsang ma gro mor spyugs/ btsun mo dam pa dang*/ bran kha dpal yon nyes med la skyon phab/ rgyal po nyid kyang dgung lo so drug pa shing mo bya la/ cog ro legs sgra dang*/ lha gdong gtsang gi mang gro zhang gi lha khang gi rdo skas la 'a tsud kla bzhud bla pa'i tshe/ ral gris btsabs nas bkrongs so/ khu chen ral pa can gyi bang so ni/ don mkhar mda'i g.yon gyi phyogs na yod/ ming ni khri steng rmang ri legs so skad/ de'i rtsa na rdo ring yi ge med pa zhig kyang yod/ da de ltar na rgyal po la sras med/ lha khang la mnga' gsol ba med/ rdo ring la yi ge med zer/ de yan chad la mu ne btsan po the ba'i/ rgyal sar bzhugs pa bzhi cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo*/ /rje 'bangs skyid pa'i nyi ma 'de ba'i dus yin no/ /gcen po glang dar ma chu mo lug lo ba yin/ so dgu lon pa'i dus na khri ral bkrongs nas/ khong pas rgyal srid bzung*/

lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin bzung*/ chu mo phag gi lo gzhug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang*/ blon po rgyal tau re/ stag sna can la sogs sdig la dga' ba rnams kyi bsgyur nas/ sngar nu bo la rgyal srid bskos pa'i snying gnad byas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs/ lo phyed dang bzhir sdig rgyal kho na byas/ lo zhe bzhi pa me pho stag lo'i dus/ yer pa'i lha ri snying po na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gab nas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la yod pa/ lha mo nag mos bskul nas/ lha sa'i rdo ring rtsa ru/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rgyal po bkrongs nas bros so/ /de dus rgyal po na re/ nga yang na sgrol ba lo gsum gyi phyis/ yang na lo gsum gyi sngas zer/ sdig rgyal de'i rkyen gyis/ chu mo phag nas me pho rta'i bar lo drug cu rtsa brgyad tsam/ bod du dam chos snub 'dug dar ma'i bang so 'khrul dang rgyal chen bar na yod/ de'i ming ni bang rim 'khor lo can zer ste/ rtsig 'phro la lus so skad/ glang dar ma la smad kyi steng zer ro/ /'di man chad smad sil bur song*/ dar ma grongs rting btsun mo che bas bu chung gcig btsal nas mdang mo rang la skyes pa'i bu yin byas pas/ yum ka brtan du chug zer nas/ yum brtan byung*/ des dbu ru bzung*/ chun ma la lto bor gyi sras gcig yod pa/ mar me'i 'od la srung bas 'od srung byung*/ des g.yon ru bzung*/ dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas/ rgyal rigs gcig la phyogs rigs gnyis su gyes/ blon po khu thog sbrangs shang srid dang*/ rngog pas sum sgra rje yab dang*/ rdog rgyal lto ro gel pa rnams kyi byas/ rgyal blon de rnams bsod nams chung bas/ sa mo glang la khengs log byung*/ me mo bya la bang so rnams bshig rje 'bangs bye/ rgyal khrims zhig chos khrims nyams/ phyi'i so kha shor/ bod nang 'khrugs/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i 'go tshugs nas/

dbus gtsang gi mi drug gam bcu'i mdo smad du rab tu byung nas/ bsam yas su/ bod rgyal tsha la na yab sras kyi spyan sngar slebs pa yan/ lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la/ spyir bod dang*/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgra mi grags pa byung te/ sdom pa 'bogs lan gyi bka' chad/ gtsug lag khang rnams wa khyi'i tshang bcas/ tsher phung skyes/ bshas ra lud khang byas/ lder bzo la sprang po'i sba zom bkal/ mi dge ba'i las thabs sna tshogs byung bas/ glang dar ma yab sras ni bod khams rnams la bka' drin shin tu chung ngo*/ /yum brtan dgung lo sum cu so drug la 'das te/ bang so med do/ /'od srung ni shing lo lug gi lo la pho brang yum bur btsas pa ste/ sum cu rtsa dgu la/ yar lung 'phan mdar 'das so/ /'od srung bang so 'phrul gyi rgyab na yod/ /ming ni skye'u lha bstan lags so skad/ de phyin chad bang so brtsigs pa yang nub bo/ /bstan pa phyis dar gyi byung tshul ni/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe/ dpal chu bo ri nas 'jad pa gtsang rab gsal dang*/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 'byung*/ stod lung pa dmar shākya mu ne gsum gyis/ 'dul ba'i po ti drai'u rgyab khal gcig bkal nas/ mnga' ris la braus gar log la phyin/ lo tsā ba med pas 'gro don ma byung ba hor yul bskor nas/ mdo smad an chung rnam rdzong*/ dan tig shel gyi lha khang du slebs/ de phyogs rnams sdig rgyal dang thag 'gyangs shing*/ snying rus che bas chos kyi brda mtshon tsam yang 'dug pa dang*/ bon rgan dmu zu gsal bzang bya ba'i tsha bu/ dmu zu rab gsal 'bar bya ba/ lo bco lnga pa gcig khongs rnams la dad nas/ gtsang gi mkhan po gsol g.yos slob dpon byas te/ dge tshul zhus pa'i ming*/ dge ba rab gsal du btags so/ /'di'i skabs su lha sar/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sdig rgyal bsad nas bros pa'ang*/ mdo smad du khong rnams 'dzoms pa'i dge ba rab gsal bsnyen rdzogs byed pa la/

sngar gyi mkhan slob dang*/ dmar gyi gsang ston byas/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi rgyal po bsad pas kha skong mi rung zer/ rgya'i ha shang ke wang dang*/ gyi wan bya ba btsal nas/ de rnams kyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs byas/ ming dgongs pa rab gsal du grags zhing*/ des bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang zhes zer ro/ /der rting lo lnga nas/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mkhan po mdzad/ spang gong ye shes g.yung drung dang*/ par rin gsal/ 'al rdo rje dbang phyug snubs rak+shi ta/ jo bo ye shes seng ge cog ro shes rab byang chub rnams/ dge tshul sgrub tu bcug pa/ mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas/ bla chen gyi slob ma la snga ba khams kyi zog po mi drug bya bar grags pa byung*/ bla chen gyi bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba yang de rnams la byas par byed de/bzhi ni zhwa theb kyi mu thum dang*/ bla gos kyi mtha' mtshams dang*/ tor bu/ ka pa la'i nang rnams sngon por mdzad pa/ bla chen dang po bon po'i rgyud par song bas/ thugs zhen gyi brda mtshon yin zer bar 'dug de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan/ bsam yas nas yum brtan gyi rgyal rgyud/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras kyi gsan nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi drug mdo smad du chos 'tshol ba la btang ba ni/ dbus nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ gtsang nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang bzhi pos/ bla chen dngos la sdom pa blangs/ rba btsun blo gros dbang phyug dang*/ rak+shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes 'byung gnas gsum pos/ grum snubs gnyis la sdom pa blangs te/ de rnams la rba rag gnyis po gcig tu dril bas/ mi drug zer ro/ /yang dbus pa gsum dang*/ gtsang pa gsum/ gtsang min dbus min gcig dang*/ mi bdun zer ba yang 'dug yang dbus gtsang gi mi bcur byed pa yang yod pa ni/ klu me shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/

klan shes rab 'bar/ rba blo gros dbang phyug rak+shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas rnams la dbus pa mi lnga dang*/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tshong btsun shes rab seng ge u pa lte dkar/ 'o brgyad spun gnyis rnams la/ gtsang pa mi lnga zer ba 'dug pa| rim pa bzhin/ phyin pas mang du song pa yin nam snyam/ gang ltar yang khong rnams kyi sdom pa blangs chos mang du zhus nas/ yar yong dus bla chen gyi zhal nas/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs shig tshong dge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring kha bkod mkhas pas gzhi zung*/ thams cad kyi bstan pa dar ba'i khur khur gsungs nas/ brdzangs pa bzhin khong rnams yar slebs nas/ rgyal po dang mjal/ bya dga' dang bkur sti chen po byas nas/ thog mar thams cad 'dzoms nas/ myang smad rgyan gong gi lha khang bzhengs/ de rting dbus gtsang gi char/ rang rang so so nas khas len byas pa'i gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na/ bstan pa phyi dar la/ a mes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang*/ slob ma dbus gtsang gi mi rnams/ sbyin bdag mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras dang bcas pa thog ma sku drin shin tu che ba lags/ rgyal po glang dar ma'i sras gnyis la gdung rgyud ji ltar byung na/ gcen yum brtan dang*/ pa tshab bza' bkra shis mtsho'i sras/ khri lde mgon gnyen/ de'i sras khri lde rig pa mgon dang*/ nyi ma mgon dang*/ gcung de'i sras la/ nyi 'od dpal mgon de'i rgyud/ klung shod 'phan yul mdo khams na mang ngo*/ /gcen po'i sras khri lde so dang*/ rdo rje 'bar lde so'i rgyud/ bug pa can dang*/ thang lha brag pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sras khri dbang phyug btsan/ de'i sras tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri pa yab sras/ 'di gnyis kyi dbus gtsang gi mi rnams mdo smad nas chos 'tshol ba la rim par brdzangs pa dang*/

dge 'dun gyi sde/ lha khang bzhengs pa/ bsam yas chos mkho sgrub pa la sogs/ bod dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i bdag rkyen brjid khur che bar mdzad do/ khri pa'i sras a tsa ra dang*/ dge slong bla ma bau dhi rā dza rnams so/ /a tsa ra'i rgyud 'khrong po pa/ gtsang rgyab pa/ glags pa lam pa/ grib pa/ snye thang pa/ khum pa btsad po la sogs pa'o/ /bla ma la rgyud med/ dge slong gi spel bzhi pa/ bo dhi rā dza'i rgyud/ lha btsun sngon mo/ gnyug rum pa/ lha 'bri sgang pa la sogs pa byung*/ da lta 'on mdo chab thang btsad po rnams so/ /de rnams yum brtan gyi rgyud yin no/ khri lde 'od srung dang*/ cog ro bza' rgyal mo legs kyi sras/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan shing mo bya la yar klungs 'phang mdar 'khrungs/ yab mes kyi mdzad spyod ngan pa bor nas/ myang smad sgrol bu'i sman lung la sogs gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs/ blon po spyang rgan a po dang*/ 'bro gtsug dgra lha ldong gis byas/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa la/ gnyags stag rtse bas yar klungs shor por bkrongs so/ /'di pa dang yum brtan gyi sras/ khri lde mgon gnyan dang*/ tsha bo rig pa mgon gyi ring la/ sa mo glang la khengs log dang*/ bang so bshig pa/ sku mkhar rtse nas 'bebs pa la sogs byung bar byed/ de'i btsun mo tshe spong bza' dkar rgyal g.yo rur bzhag pa'i sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ chun ma dba' bza' 'phen rgyal/ dbu rur bzhag pa'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal lo/ /de gnyis kyi srid phal che ba yum brtan tshang gis khyer bas/ sku mched gnyis rim pas mnga' ris stod phyogs la bros ste nyi ma mgon la/ sras dpal gyi mgon dang*/ bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug mgon rnams byung ba la/ stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ /yab skyid ldai nyi ma mgon gyi sngon ma byon nas/ stod yul rnams mnga' 'og tu bsdus pas/ phyi ma la mnga' ris zer cing*/

sras che bas mar yul dang*/ nub ral la mnga' byas/ bar pas zhang zhung dang spyi cog gnyis/ snyi gong ru thog gnyis/ pu rangs pa dang ya tshe gnyis/ drug la mnga' byed/ chung bas gar zha dang*/ zangs dkar la mnga' byed du bcug de nas mnga' ris skor gsum du grags so/ /bkra shis mgon sku mkhar nyi zangs su bzhugs so/ /sras 'khor re srong nge gnyis/ 'khor re'i sras na ga rā dza dang*/ de ba rā dza'o/ /yab 'khor re'i sku tshe smad la yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas thugs skyo nas/ gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bzhed pa la/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po med par rten gyi drung du bslab nos te/ mtshan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya ba ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan pa ltar ro/ /des mtho lding gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/ sras gnyis kyang rab tu byung te/ zhi ba 'od dang byang chub 'od/ yab sras de gnyis kyi ya rabs kyi khye'u blo rnau ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rab tu byung nas/ kha cher chos 'tshol ba la btang bas/ gzhan bcu dgu tshad pas shi/ mdo sde las lung bstan pa'i g.yas ru gzhung pa/ lhung bzor rin chen bzang po la/ dge slong bya'i gdong pa can du grags pa de lo chen dang*/ yar 'brog mtsho'i 'gram pa| ri nang pa legs pa'i shes rab kyi lo chung du gyur pa de gnyis kyis lo tsā dang chos mkhas pa lobs nas tshur slebs/ lha bla ma la da lta rgya gar shar nub kun na/ jo bo di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na las lhag pa mi 'dug zhus pas/ cis kyang gdan 'drongs pa zhig byed gsungs nas/ gtsang stag tshal bas lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng dang nag tsho gnyis/ 'khor mang po dang bcas nas thebs su btang*/ lha bla ma rang gi kyang rgyal srid gcung la gtad nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen gyi gser 'tshol ba la/ rgya gar mtha' 'khob la byon pas mu stegs rgyal pos btson du bzung*/ de blu ba'i rtsis kyi bod 'bangs byin po la/

sras gnyis pos gser bsdus pas/ sku lus dang mnyam pa'i gser 'dus na'ang*/ dbu tsam zhig ma byung ba la rnyed nas lha bla ma mu stegs pas bkrongs/ zhal chems la khyed rnams kyi byed lugs de ka yin te/ nga blus kyang nga rgas pas/ sems can la phan mi thogs/ gser rnyed pa rnams kyis jo bo dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa rnams gdan drongs/ mtho lding du mchod pa chen po shoms/ yab mes kyi bzhengs pa'i lha sa dang*/ bsam yas la sogs pa la zhig gsos gyis/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs rtsol gyis shig gsungs nas bzhag 'dug de'i skabs su gcung srong nge'i sras/ lha ldes paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ ti dang*/ phra la ring mo spyan drangs nas chos bsgyur rtsis la/ lo tsā ba bal por pho log byung nas shi chos bsgyur mkhan ni med/ sngar shes pa rnams nyams su len mkhan ni yod de lo tsā med pas paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis po bod du lo 'ga' yang 'khyams so/ /de'i tshe bal po rme ru rtse bya ba/ bod du yong chos bshad na'ang lo tsā ba med pas/ ma go bar phar log de mtshams lo mang rab kyi bar la lo paṇa gyi 'byon zhud chad do// de rting lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi btang ba'i/ rgya brtson seng dang*/ nag tshos/ jo bo rje spyan 'draungs nas bal por phebs dus/ rgya brtson seng la mu stegs pa'i ngan sngags byung nas 'das/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod spyi mthun la rgya brtson seng mi 'chi ba'i bsod nams yang mi 'dug da lo tsā mkhas pa med pas nga phyin kyang bod la phan mi thogs/ phyir log 'gro gsungs pa la/ nag tshos/ lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po la sogs pa yod pas/ zhu ba nan skyed pas/ mtho lding du yon mchod zhal mjal/ chos mang po bsgyur/ mnga' ris dbus gtsang gi sa char lo mang po bzhugs/ rten rab gnas med pa la rab gnas/ yon bsngo ba med pa la bsngo ba/ gshin dge ba med pa la dge rtsa gtong ba la sogs/ dge ba dkar phyogs 'phel ba'i srol mang po btaud/

dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na/ jo bo yon mchod slob dpon de rnams/ bod la bka' drin shin du che'o/ /de'i dngos slob khu rngaug 'brom gsum la sogs/ bka' gdams pa'i rgyud 'dzin sde dgon dar rgyas che bar byung ngo*/ /jo bo rje'i gsung*/ lo chen rin chen bzang po rnams kyis bsgyur ba yan gyi/ sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la snga 'gyur zhes grags so/ /jo bo de nyid ni dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/ shing pho rta lo'i zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang nas dga' ldan du zhi bar gshegs so/ /gcung srong nge'i sras/ lha lde dang gnam la 'od chen/ u pa dang gsum byung te/ yab sras de bas kho char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ paṇ+ḍi ta pun+ye shrī spyan drangs so/ /lha lde'i sras 'od ldais rgyal srid bskyangs/ lha btsun byang chub 'od dang*/ gcung 'od zer go cha gsum mo/ /yab sras 'di pas paṇ+ḍi ta shraṃ dha ka ra warma/ dharma pā la/ pad+mā ka ra rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis gsungs pa lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas la sogs kyis bsgyur ba man nas/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur zhes pa'i 'go tshugs/ gcen po 'od ldes/ dzñā na shrī spyan drangs/ 'od lde'i sras mnga' bdag rtse lde'i ring la/ rgya gar na mkhan po zhi ba bzang po/ mkhas pa dzñā na shrī/ 'chi med sa ra hi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/ btsun mo can/ paṇ+ḍi ta pu n+ye shrī/ su sid+dhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kirti/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa/ gser gyi go cha/ bal po bha lan+ṭa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ gzu dga' rdor/ gzhon nu mchog chos seng*/ khyung po grags seng*/ gu ru rin chen grags/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab/ gnyan chung dar ma grags/ cog ro chos mchog mar pa do pa/ lho brag mar pa lo tsā/

pa tshab nyi ma grags/ rma ban chos 'bar/ rwa lo/ cal lo/ sa lo kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ khro lo byams pa dpal la sogs pa/ rgya bod gyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang pos/ sngags mtshan nyid/ bka' bstan bcos dpag tu med pa bsgyur/ bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pas/ bka' drin shin tu nas kyang che'o/ khyad par gyis kyang mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sku tshe'i smad la/ khro lo byams pa'i dpal rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren du btang bas/ kha che'i paṇa chen shākya shrī zhes pa de nyid/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhes na'ang*/ yi dam kyi lung bstan byung bas/ me pho rta lo la gdan drongs/ bod yul du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ sa khro lcal gsum la sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang du spel/ gtsang so ba tshul khrims mdzes dang*/ rdor byang rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i slob ma bskos nas/ bstan pa'i srol btsugs/ bod kyi spyi mchod tshogs pa sde bzhir grags pa'i/ bstan pa'i rgyun chu bo'i gzhung ltar gsal ba 'di nyid mdzad cing*/ dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa la rgya gar la bzhud/ go dgu bzhes pa me yos la chos dbyings su gshegs par gda'o/ /mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sras/ bha lde/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ lde bha lde/ na ga lde pa rnams byon/ 'di yan chod la gu ge spu rangs/ mar yul la sogs pa'i btsan po rnams chad par 'dod cing*/ dpal 'khor btsan man chad 'di la/ sngon rabs kyi yig tshang dang mi mthun pa 'ga' re snang ngo*/ /na ga lde'i sras btsan phyug ldai ya rtser byon/ de'i sras bkra shis ldai/ de'i sras bkra btsan ldai/ de'i sras grags pa ldes/ gser phye bre bcu bdun la/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhengs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi la mchod rtain bzhengs/ dngul dkar lnga brgya la phag dkar dang lhan skyes bzhengs/ dngul dkar stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi byams pa bzhengs/ gsungs rab mang po bzhengs so/ /de'i sras a sogs ldes/ rdo rje gdan du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis phul ba'i grong bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis sog po las nyos nas/

rdo rje gdan du phul/ rin dngul dkar bcu gnyis re/ lo re bzhin sog po la gdab pa byas so/ /de'i sras 'dze dar smal dang*/ a nan smal la/ pho bos/ kyai rdor lha dgu dngul dkar lugs su bzhengs/ nu bos rdo rje gdan gsos/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ de'i sras re'u smal gyis rgya gar nas rgyal khams mang du blang*/ dngul dkar bzhi bcu la sman lha mched brgyad bzhengs/ lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ de'i sras saṅga smal yin/ ji dar smal gyi sras/ ar 'ji smal gyis gser dkar bcu gcig la sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs/ rgyal sa ma thob gong du sa skyar lha btsun byas/ de'i sras yar rtser skyes pa sri ti smal dang*/ dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri chen mo dang*/ lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi steng du gser thog byas so/ /de rnams gcen skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi rgyud pa yin no/ /gcung po khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras/ dpal lde 'od lde skyid de rnams la smad kyi ldai gsum zer/ yab sras 'di pa mnga' ris gung thang man la chags te/ dpal lde'i rgyud sngon po'i tshon po la thug pa ni/ khab gung thang pa/ klu rgyal gling pa/ sla lung*/ gtsang skor ba rnams te/ las stod yan chod rnams so/ /gcung skyid ldai 'jad rta nag na yod pa rnams so/ /gcig ni rgyud btsan po rgyal ba 'od la thug pa ste/ gtsang grom pa rgyang myang stod na yod pa rnams so// 'od ldai'i rgyud gtsang g.yas ru na yod de/ skyid mkhar btsad po la thug cing*/ shar tsong kha'i rgyal po gcen mnga' 'od chen la sogs pa/ mdo smad kyi rgyal rgyud rnams kyang yin no/ /mnga' bdag khri chung gi ring la/ yar klungs su byon te/ de'i rgyud dbus kyi btsad po 'od srung pa rnams yin pa/ de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/ de'i sras bdun gyi che ba/ zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/ gtsang pa tsha drug khri ldai 'bar la sras drug gi

g.yu thog pa'i rgyud sna mo ba/ 'phying nga pa/ don mkhar pa/ thang 'khor ba rnams yin no/ /bye chung lha sgom gdung chad/ gung lde 'od 'bar/ spe skyar gdung chad/ zla ba'i rgyud/ rta bshags pa dang*/ gra sna ba yin no/ khri thog thag ma ru sper gdung chad/ chung ba/ bzhengs spyan 'bar gyi rgyud/ mon mkhar ba/ zhang mda' ba/ spun bdun thang pa rnams so/ /lha ston dkar mo'i rgyud bye chung ba rnams yin no/ /gtsang pa tsha drug la/ 'od btsan/ lha btsan/ gung btsan gsum gyi rgyud/ bying ba'i btsad po rnams yin no/ /lhun po'i rgyud bya ra na yod/ da ri'i rgyud khram drug pa dang*/ chu mig gog po ba rnams te/ 'od srung gi rgyud yin no/ /bod kyi rgyal rabs byung tshul 'di la/ yar klungs jo bo dang*/ byang ji ston pa/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje la sogs kyis bsgrigs pa'i yig tshang rnams nas/ legs par btus te/ bsdebs pa yin cing*/ yar rtse'i rgyal rabs ni gser thog pa rin rdor la zhib par dris nas bris pa yin zer bar 'dug mdo rgyud mkhas mang phal cher bzhed mthun par/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga stong gnas pa la/ /thub dbang sa pho 'brug la 'khrungs pa nas/ /lo grangs chig stong lnga brgya sum cu drug /'das pa'i chu bo khyi la bod rgyal gyi/ /snga ba gnya' khri btsan po rgyal sar byon/ /de nas dgu brgya drug cu rtsa gcig la/ khyi lo tho ri snyan btsan byon pa nas/ /brgya dang go bdun song ba'i me mo glang*/ /srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs nas chig brgya dang*/ /don bzhi lcags rta lo la brag dmar du/ khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs rting don drug pa'i/ /me pho khyi la mnga' bdag khri ral 'khrungs/ /so drug lcags bya'i bar la rgyal srid bzung*/ /de yan rgyal rabs bzhi bcu zhe gnyis byon/ /de rting chu mo phag nas lcags rta'i bar/ /drug cu rtsa brgyad dar mas bstan pa bsnubs/ /bod khams dbus gtsang dam chos sgra mi grags/

/de nas bstan pa phyi dar me stag lo/ /paṇa chen byon pa yan la nyis brgya dang*/ /dgu bcu go bdun me stag de lo nas/ /deng sang shing stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yan/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad sngar 'das kun/ /dril bas sum stong lnga brgya gya lnga song*/ /ma 'ongs bstan pa'i lhag ma chig stong dang*/ /bzhi brgya bco lnga yod pa brtsi ba la/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya the zhes lo/ /'di don go ba'i skyes bu shes ldan kun/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me gsal dus 'dir/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam la 'jug pa rigs/ /chos rgyal rgyal rabs 'di bris dge ba yis/ /thub bstan bstan pa'i sgor zhugs 'phags tshogs kyi/ /bstan 'dzin 'dzin ma'i ngos kun khyab gyur nas// 'gro kun kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog/ //
